name: Compresyn
description: Compresyn is a precision SNT-interface compound that accelerates the cycling of sleep stages, cycling through all necessary NREM and REM phases at approximately 2.7x normal speed while preserving the physiological restoration yield of a full 8-hour sleep. A full restorative night is achieved in 2.5-3.2 hours, after which the compound terminates sleep and the user wakes refreshed. It requires a calibrated BCI to monitor and regulate stage transitions — without one, it is dangerously unpredictable.
effects: Full physiological restoration of 8-hour sleep achieved in 2.5-3.2 hours
Complete REM and NREM cycling preserved
Sustained cognitive performance equivalent to fully rested baseline
side_effects: BCI-dependent — without neural monitoring, stage acceleration can cause micro-seizures
Dreams are experienced at accelerated pace and are often fragmented and disorienting
Long-term use disrupts natural circadian rhythm, body loses ability to self-regulate sleep timing
Extremely expensive; counterfeit versions on gray market cause cardiac arrhythmia
Mild headache and jaw tension for 1-2 hours post-wake
cultural_context: Compresyn is the ultimate Tier 4-5 status commodity — buying back time itself. Spire executives, high-frequency traders, and corporate attorneys use it as a matter of professional expectation; sleeping full hours is for people who can't afford not to. Some Tier 4 users take it nightly for years, functionally eliminating sleep from their schedules. The counterfeit market is deadly — gray-market Compresyn without BCI regulation has killed a dozen Tier 2 users who bought it hoping to compete.
story_hooks: The counterfeit Compresyn supply chain leads back to a Nightshade Pharmatech front operation — they're deliberately producing dangerous analogs to corner the gray market while Lazarus holds the legitimate prescription monopoly.

A Tier 5 Spire executive who has used Compresyn nightly for six years begins experiencing waking hallucinations that appear to be compressed, unprocessed dream content surfacing involuntarily — and they're starting to appear during board presentations.

A Tier 2 fixer acquires a single legitimate Compresyn dose and uses it before a critical job — but the accelerated dream cycle surfaces a suppressed memory that changes everything they thought they knew about the job they're about to do.
